label: About Us
title: Dubai-Based Medical Gloves Distribution
paragraph1: Elite Gloves Trading L.L.C is a Dubai-based medical gloves distribution company serving the UAE & GCC markets. As the authorized distributor of Viet Glove Corporation, we provide stable and certified medical glove supply supported by strong manufacturing capabilities in Vietnam.
paragraph2: Our manufacturing partner, Viet Glove Corporation, operates certified production facilities in Vietnam with a rigorous quality management system meeting international standards. Together, we deliver reliable supply with competitive pricing and consistent quality to the GCC healthcare market.
